address: rue de la Hate 1, Corbion, 6838, Belgium
bio: The Maqua family’s charming hotel has been welcoming guests in the Ardennes since 1900 and several generations continue to work in the family establishment. The peaceful rooms overlook the rolling countryside, while in the restaurant, the accent is on satisfying French favourites, albeit in keeping with today’s tastebuds. The cooking is spot on and flavoursome. Splendid wine cellar....
